links.outcome: Factuality and completeness of ChatGPT discharge summaries versus resident summaries
links.effect: Resident summaries significantly outperformed AI summaries in quality (p = 0.011), factuality (p < 0.002), and completeness (p < 0.001) but not readability (p = 0.08).
links.quote: Resident summaries significantly outperformed AI summaries in quality (p = 0.011), factuality (p < 0.002), and completeness (p < 0.001) but not in readability (p = 0.08).

screen.reason: Empirical pilot study evaluating the performance of ChatGPT in generating discharge summaries from medical histories compared to junior residents; does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
